messages:
toni: hi team, my partner's 24yo is starting grad school full-time in sept and will enroll in their university plan. open enrollment is closed here. can i remove them effective 2026-09-01? also curious about premium refunds for Sept and impact on my HSA/commuter elections.

Harpreet (People Ops): hi @toni 44b yes this counts as a QLE (gain of other coverage). please upload the university enrollment confirmation showing the 9/1 effective date to https://benefits.redwood.example/upload under "QLE - Other Coverage" within 30 days.

toni: uploaded enrollment_confirm_090126.pdf. can removal be same-day 9/1 or end of 8/31? want to avoid overlap.

Olivia (Benefits): with verification we typically set termination effective 8/31 11:59pm to avoid duplicate employer coverage on 9/1, but we can align to 9/1 if you prefer. let us know. digital ID access will be removed upon termination.

ton i: prefer ending 8/31. what about Sept premiums taken last paycheck?

Jon (Payroll): if premiums were withheld, Payroll will issue a refund or apply a credit on the next payroll after termination posts. small refunds on one check, large amounts can be split per employee request. i'll calculate once Benefits posts the effective date.

toni: commuter pre-tax deductions 68c currently set monthly. do those stop automatically if dependent removed?

Olivia (Benefits): commuter elections are independent of dependent status and typically continue unless you change them. if you no longer need commuter pre-tax because of location change, update via the benefits portal.

toni: HSA?

Olivia (Benefits): if you drop to self-only mid-year, HSA contribution limits change pro rata. we'll provide an updated contribution cap and send the payroll HSA adjustment form.

BenefitsBot: Auto-acknowledged upload received (enrollment_confirm_090126.pdf). Missing: proof of identity for dependent if not on file.

Harpreet (People Ops): next steps: Benefits to approve termination (Olivia), Payroll to compute refund and HSA adjustment (Jon). Target ETA 3 business days. ping here if no update.

toni: thanks all 64f

Jon (Payroll): noted, i'll DM you the refund timing once Benefits posts the change.
